submitted.body:
The owner supplied the six-digit React Bits **CodeSlots** control (TypeScript + Tailwind variant). The verbatim source and integration notes are captured at `Edge/workspace/PI-03/CodeSlots.tsx` and `Edge/workspace/PI-03/CodeSlots.integration.md`; copy the source into the v0.3 client during this item.

Dependencies: `motion` is new; `@hugeicons/react` and `@hugeicons/core-free-icons` are already in the client. The client has no Tailwind and the source uses Tailwind v4 syntax, so either port the classes to a scoped CSS file (recommended) or add Tailwind v4 with preflight disabled. Use the control for invite redemption and member reset; the 16-character owner recovery code stays a standard field.
